correctness.rationale: For every total function, the operators are exactly \(C(A)=f^{-1}[f[A]]\) and \(I(A)=A\cap f[X]\), so they commute if and only if the range is fiber-saturated; the test \(A=X\setminus f[X]\) proves necessity and intersection with a saturated set proves sufficiency. The equivalence with homogeneous incoming siblings is exact. The noncycle nonleaf rooted-tree class obeys \(u=z(\exp z+\exp u-2)\), while cycle vertices have only nonleaf offcycle branches, giving \(A=1/(1-z\exp u)\). At the unique critical point \(\rho\), one has \(H_u=0\), \(H_z=-B\), \(H_{uu}=-1\); nonnegative aperiodic coefficients force the unique dominant square root, yielding the stated transfer asymptotic. Exhaustive structural counts to size six and original modal semantics to size five were replayed, without confusing finite checks with the general proof.

value.rationale: For deterministic two-way temporal semantics, exact commutation of the canonical past/future round trips is a natural nonautomatic structural property. Beyond the elementary equivalence, a reversible constrained-tree decomposition gives the entire labelled count and exact exponential rarity among all endofunctions. These quantitative consequences answer a motivated nontrivial classification question, rather than adding an arbitrary parameter or restating a known table.
